page_title: BET 4-0 GET | Betis v Getafe 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+9' Wasted effort! Luis Milla (Getafe) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
90+9' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle as Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+8' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

90+8' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Marc Roca (Betis) sends a long cross over to Cucho Hernandez, but David Soria comes forward to gather the ball.
90+6' Alex Sancris (Getafe) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+4' The percentage of ball possession is – 51:49.
90+1' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner with a short pass.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

89' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Alvaro Valles anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Getafe!
86' Referee Miguel Sesma makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
86' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Pablo Fornals and he is replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
86' That will be all from Angel Ortiz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Hector Bellerin (Betis).
85' One of the Getafe players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
85' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) takes the corner which is cleared.
81' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Betis due to an offside in the build-up play.
81' The Betis players halt their celebrations as referee Miguel Sesma makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
79' Goal! Pablo Fornals (Betis) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 5:0.
78' Juanmi (Getafe) serves up a nice cross, but Alvaro Valles punches the ball away.
75' The game has come to an end for Aitor Ruibal. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis).
73' The linesman makes the right call and Getafe will have a corner.
72' The attendance for today's match is 54365.
70' The current number of shots on goal is 8:1.
69' The ball goes out of play and Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Natan is replaced by Valentin Gomez (Betis).
66' A substitution has been made. Antony goes off and Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) comes on.

65' Antony (Betis) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but David Soria anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
64' Referee Miguel Sesma points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Betis players celebrate.
62' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Betis players aren’t happy.
60' 4 - 0 Goal! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:0.

60' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but David Soria pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
58' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Adrian Liso will be replaced by Alex Sancris (Getafe).
58' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Diego Rico (Getafe) replacing Allan Nyom.
58' Substitution. Kiko Femenia is replaced by Juanmi (Getafe).
58' Substitution. Mario Martin makes his way off the pitch and Javier Munoz (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
58' Celebrations are cut short for Getafe as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
57' The Getafe players joy may have been justified, because referee Miguel Sesma is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
56' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Borja Mayoral (Getafe) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
56' Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

52' 3 - 0 Goal! Cucho Hernandez displays great vision and sends a pass to Pablo Fornals (Betis), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 3:0.
51' Antony (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Sesma had a clear view and blows his whistle.

49' 2 - 0 Aitor Ruibal (Betis) picks up a rebound just outside the box, steadies himself and unleashes a cracker that deflects off the right post into the back of the net, beating the helpless goalkeeper.
49' Off the post! Antony (Betis) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range bounced off the left post.
47' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle. Nelson Deossa (Betis) commits a foul after dangerous play.
47' Getafe are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker.
45+1' Antony (Betis) threads a pass through to Pablo Fornals, but David Soria breaks up the move.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Pablo Fornals (Betis) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
44' The corner from Pablo Fornals (Betis) is intercepted by the defence. Betis get a corner.
44' Marc Roca (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Antony (Betis) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
43' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

42' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) wins the aerial duel to reach the cross from Adrian Liso, but the ball slips off his head and flies well wide of the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

42' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top right corner. His long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
42' Pablo Fornals (Betis) steps up to send the ball in.
41' Nelson Deossa (Betis) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. It will be a corner kick for Betis.

39' The opposition back off Pablo Fornals (Betis) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
37' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Cucho Hernandez (Betis) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
34' Antony (Betis) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
31' Marc Roca (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 3:0.
27' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
27' Rough tackle by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
25' Luis Milla (Getafe) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

23' Antony sends a slide-rule pass into the feet of Aitor Ruibal (Betis), who without a second thought fires a shot in on goal from mid-range which only goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
23' Pablo Fornals (Betis) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Allan Nyom (Getafe) was quite harsh and Miguel Sesma didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' The ratio of the ball possession is 46:54.
21' Antony (Betis) sends a chip pass into the box, but David Soria is quickest to intercept the ball.
20' Pablo Fornals (Betis) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
20' Mario Martin (Getafe) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Betis are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
19' Some patient build-up play from Betis as they look to unlock the defence.

16' 1 - 0 Goal! Antony hands Aitor Ruibal (Betis) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
15' Pablo Fornals (Betis) plays a one-two with Cucho Hernandez, but the move breaks down.
13' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) watches the cross in from Angel Ortiz, but plants his header from the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post.
11' Pablo Fornals (Betis) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul.
9' Antony (Betis) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
9' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
7' Antony (Betis) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

6' Pablo Fornals (Betis) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
6' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Antony (Betis) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but David Soria was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
4' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
2' The ball is cleared after Borja Mayoral (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Getafe will kick the game off.
Miguel Sesma will officiate today.
